query: Key contributions and follow-ups of 'Attention Is All You Need' (2017)
highlights: The Transformer model introduced scaled dot-product attention mechanism [1, p.4, Fig.2].
Multi-head attention allows the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces [1, p.4, Fig.2].
The Transformer architecture achieved higher BLEU scores compared to previous state-of-the-art models on English-to-German and English-to-French translations [1, p.8].
Table 3 shows variations of the Transformer architecture with performance metrics on English-to-German translation tasks [1, p.9].
